Coppock, Alexander. 2025. <b>metaprep: Tidy Preparation of Dependent Effect Estimates for Meta-Analysis</b>. R package version 0.4.0.

# Abstract
A tidy workflow for preparing dependent effect estimates for meta-analysis. Many studies contribute several correlated estimates, for example multiple treatment arms compared with a shared control, and the estimates_vcov object keeps those estimates and their block-diagonal variance-covariance matrix synchronized through dplyr operations. It then passes them to metafor for multi-arm meta-analysis, including cluster-robust standard errors.
